crops.name: Cotton
crops.description: Gujarat no mukhya raqdi pako. Kala ane loamy mati ma saras uge che.
crops.description_en: Gujarat's main cash crop. Grows well in black and loamy soils.

crops.name: Groundnut
crops.description: Gujarat ma sauthi vadhare ugadto tel-pako. Sandy loam mati saras.
crops.description_en: Most widely grown oilseed crop in Gujarat. Sandy loam soil is best.

crops.name: Rice
crops.description: Dakshina Gujarat ane Saurashtra ma ugaday che. Pani ni vadhu jarur.
crops.description_en: Grown in South Gujarat and Saurashtra. Needs high water.

crops.name: Wheat
crops.description: Rabi sezanno mukhya pako. Uttar Gujarat ma saras uge.
crops.description_en: Main Rabi season crop. Grows well in North Gujarat.

crops.name: Bajra
crops.description: Ocha pani ma ugadtu Saurashtra-Kutch no pako. Dushkal ma pan thay.
crops.description_en: Drought-resistant crop of Saurashtra-Kutch. Needs very little water.

crops.name: Sugarcane
crops.description: South Gujarat ma ugaday. Kheda, Surat, Anand district ma vadhare.
crops.description_en: Grown in South Gujarat. More in Kheda, Surat, Anand districts.

crops.name: Castor
crops.description: Gujarat vishvano sabse moto erando utpadak. Mehsana, Banaskantha ma saras.
crops.description_en: Gujarat is world's largest castor producer. Best in Mehsana, Banaskantha.

crops.name: Maize
crops.description: Kharif ane Rabi be sezanma thay. Pashupalan mate upayogi.
crops.description_en: Grown in both Kharif and Rabi. Useful for animal feed.

crops.name: Cumin
crops.description: Gujarat-Rajasthan no pacho mashala pako. Sauthi vadhare Banaskantha ma ugade.
crops.description_en: Major spice crop of Gujarat-Rajasthan belt. Most grown in Banaskantha.

crops.name: Onion
crops.description: Gujarat ma uunchaa bhav melo shaakbhaji pako. Bhavnagar, Rajkot ma vadhare.
crops.description_en: High-value vegetable crop in Gujarat. More in Bhavnagar, Rajkot.

crops.name: Tomato
crops.description: Baramase ugadtu shaakbhaji. Gujarat ma mandi bhav saras male che.
crops.description_en: Year-round vegetable crop. Good mandi prices available in Gujarat.

crops.name: Mango
crops.description: Gir-Kesar aam vishvaprasiddha. Junagadh, Amreli, Bhavnagar ni visheshata.
crops.description_en: Gir Kesar mango is world-famous. Specialty of Junagadh, Amreli, Bhavnagar.

crops.name: Mustard
crops.description: Uttar Gujarat no mukhya Rabi tel-pako. Banaskantha, Mehsana ma saras.
crops.description_en: Main Rabi oilseed crop of North Gujarat. Grows well in Banaskantha and Mehsana.

crops.name: Sesame
crops.description: Ocha pani ma thay che. Amreli, Bhavnagar, Surendranagar ma vadhu vavyo hoy che.
crops.description_en: Low water requiring traditional crop. Widely cultivated in Amreli and Bhavnagar.

crops.name: Chickpea
crops.description: Saurashtra ane Bhal vistar ma mukhya kathol pako. Bhalia chana prasiddha che.
crops.description_en: Leading pulse crop in Saurashtra and Bhal region. Highly reputed for quality.
